data.one_liner: Defines the platform interface for the Flutter VLC player plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides an abstract VlcPlatform class that platform implementations must extend. Ensures consistent API across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux implementations.
use_when: You need to create or use a custom platform implementation for VLC playback.
You want a stable contract for a Flutter VLC plugin across multiple platforms.
avoid_when: You only need a ready‑made video player without writing platform code.
strengths: Clear separation between interface and implementation
Supports all major desktop and mobile platforms
weaknesses: Contains no actual playback logic – requires a separate implementation
Limited to VLC features; not a full‑featured player on its own

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a ready‑to‑use video player without needing a separate platform interface.
